title: fix: read /source and editor files as UTF-8

files.patch:
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@ Upcoming (TBD)
 
 Bug Fixes
 --------
+* Read `/source` files and the `\e` editor file as UTF-8 instead of the locale encoding, so non-ASCII SQL no longer fails or is mis-decoded under non-UTF-8 locales.
 * Open the audit log and the `\T`/`\o` output files as UTF-8, so non-ASCII output no longer fails under non-UTF-8 locales.
 * Support `DELIMITER` in batch input (`mycli < file.sql`, `--batch`), so dumps with triggers or routines restore.

+def test_execute_from_file_does_not_use_locale_encoding(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    # SQL files are commonly UTF-8; the locale encoding (cp1252, cp932, ...) would
+    # mis-decode or reject them.  EncodingWarning is raised for any open() that
+    # falls back to the locale encoding.
+    sql_file = tmp_path / 'query.sql'
+    sql_file.write_text('-- caf\u00e9\nselect 1;', encoding='utf-8')
+    script = '\n'.join((
+        'import sys',
+        'from mycli.client_commands import ClientCommandsMixin',
+        'class C(ClientCommandsMixin):',
+        '    pass',
+        'try:',
+        '    list(C().execute_from_file(sys.argv[1]))',
+        'except AttributeError:',
+        '    pass',
+    ))
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, '-X', 'warn_default_encoding', '-W', 'error::EncodingWarning', '-c', script, str(sql_file)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        encoding='utf8',
+        errors='replace',
+    )
+    assert 'EncodingWarning' not in result.stderr, result.stderr
+
+

+def test_open_external_editor_filename_does_not_use_locale_encoding(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    # EncodingWarning is raised for any open() that falls back to the locale encoding.
+    filename = tmp_path / 'query.sql'
+    filename.write_text('select "caf\u00e9";\n', encoding='utf-8')
+    script = '\n'.join((
+        'import sys',
+        'import click',
+        'click.edit = lambda filename: None',
+        'from mycli.packages.special_commands import io_commands',
+        'query, message = io_commands.open_external_editor(filename=sys.argv[1])',
+        'assert message is None, message',
+        'assert query == \'select "caf\\u00e9";\', query',
+    ))
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, '-X', 'warn_default_encoding', '-W', 'error::EncodingWarning', '-c', script, str(filename)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        encoding='utf8',
+        errors='replace',
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+
